purpose: Complete the W57-owned Workstream H defect-triage field set (severity + release decision) that the previous repair left undecided, and replace the ambiguous 'route to a closed owner' framing of DEF-W57-008 with a machine-verified single-commit regression root cause and a proven one-hunk owner fix.

authority_correction.problem: The previous repair set severity_authority='undecided - classification is the release authority's call, not the W57 worker's' on every finding. No such external release authority exists anywhere in the repository (searched .opencode/protocol/*.json, .agents/protocol/*.md, rules.md, opencode/REQUIREMENT_REGISTRY.md).
authority_correction.correct_authority: Severity classification and the P2/P3 deferral decision are W57-OWNED requirements, not an external approval. opencode/REQUIREMENT_REGISTRY.md: HPC-W10-FREEZE-010='defect triage', FREEZE-019='P0: mandatory NO-GO.', FREEZE-020='P1: mandatory NO-GO.', FREEZE-021='P2: may defer only with explicit impact/workaround/owner.', FREEZE-022='P3: may defer with concise record.', FREEZE-033='No open P0/P1', FREEZE-034='Every P2/P3 has an explicit decision', FREEZE-043='defect ledger'. W57.md:127 lists 'Workstream H - Defect triage' as a mandatory source section, and opencode/sources/WAVE_V2_FINAL_10.md:318-339 requires every finding to carry ID, severity, surface, reproduction, expected, observed, owner Wave, status, release decision.
authority_correction.why_this_mattered: The undecided severity was the reason no single owner transaction could be dispatched: with severity open, P1 NO-GO was arguable, so the controller could not tell a P2 deferral from a P1 stop. Executing FREEZE-019..022 collapses 22 failures / 9 unowned causes into exactly ONE P1 with a bounded fix, and 13 node ids that are release-decidable as P2/P3.
authority_correction.classification_discipline: Where the P1/P2 boundary is genuinely contested, this ledger takes the NO-GO side. FREEZE-029's escape hatch applies only to deviations that are 'not P0/P1', so over-classifying toward P2 would manufacture a green gate; under-classifying toward P1 costs one cheap owner transaction. The asymmetry is deliberate and is not an approval.
